product: H-G Toys Par-Golf Toy Golf Clubs
title: Toy Golf Clubs Recalled by H-G Toys
tell: You can identify recalled units by model numbers 721 and 723 and by a single staple fastening the club rod to the handle, with no markings on the clubs themselves.

title: Crosman BB Pistol May Have Inoperative Safety
tell: Suspect model 454 pistols have serial numbers starting with 477, 577, 677, 777, or 877 on the left side below the name Crosman, lacking an R stamp on the right side.

product: Ambory Special, Ram, Jiffy Sr./Jr. portable immersible electric water heaters
title: Warning Issued On Electric Water Heaters
tell: The recalled units include Ambory Special, Jiffy Jr., Jiffy Sr., and Ram portable immersible electric water heaters made by the Ambory Corp.

product: American Printing House for the Blind Biological Models, Land Forms
title: Joint Recall Of Lead Painted Produce For Blind Children Announced
tell: All units of the listed 12 model numbers produced by the American Printing House for the Blind are recalled.

title: Banned "Snoopy" Bank Recalled by Ideal Toy Corporation
tell: Check the model number on the multicolored six-inch bank representing Snoopy in Joe Cool, Santa, Tuxedo, or Dog House costumes.

product: Chance Manufacturing Zipper Amusement Park Rides
title: CPSC Announces Final Ban On Lead-Containing Paint
tell: All units are not recalled; the notice announces a final regulatory ban on lead-containing paint and coated toys and furniture, rather than a specific product recall.

title: Refrigerator Repaired by Amana
tell: Check the model number and serial plate behind the removable black grill at the front; affected units have model numbers starting with SR or SD and serial numbers beginning with S, E, B, L, A, or C.

title: High Chair Recalled by Century
tell: Check the numbers on the back of the plastic seat; only units with numbers 7403 through 7412, 7501, and 7502 are affected.

product: Black & Decker weed and grass trimmers
title: Recall Of Weed And Grass Trimmers Announced
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking for model number 8209 Type 1 on the orange-colored trimmer.

title: Smoke Detectors Recalled by BRK Electronics
tell: All SS749 series smoke detectors manufactured before September 26, 1975 are recalled.

title: Recall Of Smoke alarms announced
tell: Check the serial number on the back cover under the mounting bracket to see if it falls within the recalled ranges.

title: Automatic Baseball Pitching Machines Warning
tell: All units of these automatic baseball pitching machines are recalled. They are labeled as Blazer (Champ), Professional, Range, Pro-Trainer (Olympia), or Dudley Automatic Pitching Machine.

title: Recall Of Scuba Regulators Announced
tell: All Scubapro Mark VII and Pilot Mark VII scuba regulators produced since August 25, 1976 are included in this recall.

title: Repair Of Aluminum Bats Announced
tell: Only bats sold under the trade name of King Sport are subject to this repair.

title: Product Substitution For Excedrin Announced
tell: All units of the 225 tablet and 375 tablet packages distributed prior to April 1977 are involved.

product: McGraw-Edison Air Comfort console air humidifier
title: Air Humidifiers Recalled by Air Comfort
tell: Check the rating plate on the lower right hand corner of the rear panel for the type number and serial number.

product: Marklin, Marklin Mini-Club Transformer electric train transformers
title: Electric Train Transformers Recalled by Boyd Models
tell: You can identify the recalled transformers by checking the model number printed on the metal face plate, which are 6727, 6153, and 6667, constructed of blue plastic.

product: Can Am Road Race Set electric toy road racing sets
title: Road Racing Sets & Power Pack Toy Transformers Recalled by Strombecker
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model number 9900, 9902, 9924, or power pack transformer model 9703-G, and checking for a blue-gold or blue-yellow casing with a black base labeled Power Pack Toy Tran…

title: Mr. Coffee Coffemakers Recalled by North American Systems
tell: Recalled units are identified by a letter G, H, I, J, K, or L followed by 75 etched into the upper right of the outside back cover plate.

title: Stereo Recalled by Grand Prix
tell: Consumers can identify the recalled unit by unplugging it and checking the model number 3200 located slightly to the right of center on the rear of the unit.

title: Electric Toy Train Transformers Recalled by Reeves
tell: Check the model number and markings on the metal plate or label: model 6727 says Warklin Mini-Club, model 6153 says Marklin, and model 6667 says Toy Transformer 6667 Marklin.

product: RAPCO Deluxe Double Barrel Tumble Stones Rock Polishers
title: Electric Rock Polishers Recalled by RAPCO
tell: Check the model number and label on the red plastic tumbling machine to identify Model #1901 or Model #1902.

title: Electric Defroster Recalled by Chadwick-Miller
tell: All units are recalled. The packaging box is labeled with Model No. 73359 and the name Chadwick.

title: Pacifiers Recalled by La Cibeles
tell: All units of these Chupete baby pacifiers are recalled; they feature Fauna, Flower, Texas, or Navy series handles and are marked Made in Spain on the shield.

product: Eltrinic fluorescent under the cabinet light fixtures
title: Lights Recalled by Eltrinic
tell: You can tell the recalled light fixture by style number La-l and because it is marked made in Taiwan.

title: Toy Phonograph Recalled by Electronic Creations
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled phonograph by checking the model number 54740 on the label.

product: Pride-Trimble tubular steel bed guard rails
title: CPSC Announces Bed Guard Rail Recall
tell: All units are not recalled, only Model 112 bed rails sold in cartons marked Model 112 Bed Rails and labeled Dept. 66-112-6222.

product: American Wick Company candles with lead-core candle wicks
title: Candles With Lead-Core Wicks Warn
tell: All units are not recalled, only those containing lead-core wicks produced by American Wick Company or Queens Braidworks.

product: Ponchos Recalled by Cotton City & JC Penney
title: Ponchos Recalled by Cotton City & JC Penney
tell: Check the neck label for style numbers 3050, 3051, 3052 with JCP8203, or the number 9815 for those from other stores.

product: CalComp Consumer Products Industries decorative night lights
title: Decorative Night Lights Recalled by Consumer Products Industries
tell: All units are recalled. They bear the company name on the back near the plug and have molded plastic faces.

title: Toy Balloon Recalled by Imperial
tell: Check the item numbers 028, 338, 339, 548, or 625 printed on the packaging to identify recalled units.

title: ARC Welders Recalled by Wel-Dex
tell: You can identify the recalled welders by the name Wel-Dex or Midway on the attached face plate and model numbers DD, D, E, F, DS, and K.

title: Bicycle Child Carriers Recalled by Hamill & Hufman
tell: All units of the Tote Along bicycle child carriers sold in the summer of 1976 are included in this recall.

title: DOLAX & OLLA Pacifiers Recalled
tell: All units are recalled; check for DOLAX packaging with 'Pacifier DOLAX Chupetes' or OLLA packaging with an infant picture and the name OLLA.

title: Guild Stops Manufacturing/Selling mattresses
tell: All mattresses manufactured since December 23, 1973, that do not meet federal flammability requirements are recalled.

product: La Cibeles Chupetes Fauna, Flower, Texas, Navy Baby Pacifiers
title: Baby Pacifiers Continues Recalled by La Cibeles
tell: All units of these pacifiers are recalled; the shield is marked Wade in Spain in small molded letters and the handle is shaped like an animal head, flower, or baby with a hat.

title: CPSC Announces Recall Of 250,000 Arc Welders Due To Shock Hazard
tell: You can identify the recalled welders by the name Midway on the face plate and model numbers DD, D, E, F, DS, and K.

title: Recall Of Electric Worm Probe Announced
tell: You can tell the recalled units by the name Midway appearing on the face plate and model numbers DD, D, E, F, DS, and K.

title: Cotton Sportswear Tops Recalled by May Department Stores
tell: Check the style number on the garment for MP 408, MP 409, MP 410, MP 425, MP 426, or MP 454.

product: Michael Miles/Peter Sinclair cotton sportswear tops
title: Cotton Sportswear Tops Recalled by Jerold Men's Shops
tell: You can identify the recalled tops by checking for styles MP 408, MP 409, MP 410, MP 425, MP 426, and MP 454 distributed by Michael Miles/Peter Sinclair.

title: Cotton Sportswear Tops Recalled by Garb-Age
tell: Check the style number on the garment label to see if it matches MP 408, MP 409, MP 410, MP 425, MP 426, or MP 454.

title: Greensboro Stops Sale Children'sSleepwear
tell: All units of style 1915 girls' gowns in sizes 0-6X manufactured between July 29, 1972, and July 28, 1973, are recalled.

title: Galaxy Carpet Mills Stops Sale Carpets/Rugs
tell: Recalled carpets include Laredo in mist green, autumn leaves, and exotic red, and Polara in oriental red and peacock, with specific roll and dyelot numbers.

product: Adirondack aluminum baseball bats with rubber grips
title: Aluminum Baseball Bats Replaced by Manufacturers & Distributors
tell: All units of the named aluminum baseball bats with rubber grips are recalled.

title: Rifle & Pistol Crossbows Recalled by WHAM-O
tell: All units of rifle crossbow models 106 and 108 and pistol crossbow model 718 manufactured between September 1, 1974, and March 25, 1976, are recalled.

title: Continental Stops Sale Carpets
tell: All units of the Galveston Bay carpet style are recalled.

title: Venture Stops Sale Carpets & Rugs
tell: All units of these specific styles, patterns, and colors are included in the recall: Floridian No. 6772, Grafica patterns 320 and 324, and 57th Street colors 310 and 314.

title: CPSC Warns About Possible Anthrax Contamination In Imported Yarn
tell: All units of Creative Handweavers wool yarn in gray goat, black goat, white goat, white goat/camel, gray goat/camel, black goat/camel, and 100% camel types are recalled; the skeins bear no label.

title: Airflow Mattress Stops manufacturing/importing Mattress
tell: Recalled mattresses were manufactured between June 22, 1973, and December 22, 1973.

title: Anthrax Contamination In Imported Yarn Warned by Tahki
tell: All units are not recalled; check for balls of yarn with a label that says Tahki Imports, Ltd., imported from Pakistan containing camel hair, goats hair, wool, or rayon.

title: Jorges Carpet Mills Stops Sale Carpets
tell: Contact the place of business where the carpet was purchased to determine if your Magic Affair style carpet is part of the recalled batch.

product: India Malaysia Imports Stops Sale Garments
title: India Malaysia Imports Stops Sale Garments
tell: All units of this full length gypsy style printed skirt are recalled. Look for a sewn-in label at the waist identifying it as 100% cotton, handwoven in India.

title: General Felt Stops Sale Carpets
tell: Contact the place of purchase to determine if your Fashion Right carpet is part of the specific experimental production rolls, Tigress Gold color rolls, or specific listed roll and dye lot numbers.

title: Colony Carpets Stops Sale Carpets & Rugs
tell: You can identify the recalled carpeting by checking the specific roll numbers listed in the notice for the Shalimar 301 shag carpeting with a jute back.

product: Industro R clamp-on lamps with metal reflectors
title: Lamps Warned by Woods Wire Products
tell: The lamp has a metal spring at the base of the socket surrounding the power cord, and the wire has a black vinyl covering with the trademark INDUSTRO R. Check for an insulator disc inside the socket.

product: Adirondack aluminum baseball bats with rubber grips
title: Aluminum Softball & Baseball Bats Warning
tell: All aluminum bats with black one-piece molded rubber grip sleeves and knobs sold since 1968 are involved if the rubber grip is loose, worn, damaged, or deteriorated.

title: Carpets & Rugs Recalled by Keller
tell: All units of style Caravan shaggy polyester pile carpet with jute back sold between January 27, 1972 and May 12, 1972 are recalled.

title: Carpets & Rugs Recalled by Hartford Carpet Mills
tell: Recalled units include Carmel, Hartley, and Sierra carpets manufactured between April and October 1971, as well as Carmel carpets in Autumn Bronze and Harvest Beige manufactured between May and June 1972.

title: Michael Milea & Peter Sinclair Stop Sale UnisexSportswear Tops
tell: Because non-complying and complying garments are similar in style, color and pattern, it is difficult for consumers to distinguish them, but the recalled styles are 408, 409, 410, 425, 426, and 454.

product: S. Schwab Company boys' and girls' pajamas
title: S. Schwab To Halt Sale Of Children's Pajamas
tell: You can tell the recalled pajamas by style 1170, lot 953, in pink or turquoise with white dots, sizes 1, 2, or 3.

title: Flokati Rugs Sold In Washington, D.C., Area Fail Flammability Test CPSC Alerts Public
tell: All units sold under the style name Eros S.C. are recalled.

title: Carpets Recall by Apollo Carpets
tell: All units of the Mars, Uranius, and Moonwalk carpet styles sold prior to April 1972 are recalled.

product: Kemp Shredder compost and leaf shredders
title: Compost & Leaf Shredders Repaired by Kemp Shredder
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model numbers SKO, 6-0, and 6-04 located on the shredder nameplate.

title: Medicine Cabinets Warning
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model numbers listed on a nameplate located under the bottom shelf.

product: L.P. Gas Equipment gas leak detector fluid
title: Gas Leak Detector Fluid Warning
tell: All units of the blue colored gas leak detector fluid distributed by L.P. Gas Equipment since 1972 are involved.

title: Siber Hegner Stops Importing& Selling Women's Scarves
tell: You can identify the recalled scarves by their 100 percent nylon material with metallic threads, 26 by 26 inch size, and cloth labels reading Nylon Georgette or Golden Glow Round.

title: Plymouth Shops Stops Importing & Selling Women'sScarves
tell: Recalled units are pleated 100 percent silk chiffon scarves measuring 28 by 28 inches in green, pink, brown, beige, violet, and blue, bearing three labels including a paper label reading Plymouth Shops Style No. 6244.

product: CPSC Issues Warning On Certain Christmas Lites
title: CPSC Issues Warning On Certain Christmas Lites
tell: Check the serial or model numbers listed on the front of the greenish blue and white carton.

title: Infant & Toddler's Night Wear by Lady Lovely Apparel May Not Be Sold
tell: Check the cloth label sewn into the inside shoulder seam for style numbers 632, 6130, 6131, or 6132, which are written on the backside of the label.

product: Kemp Shredder Company home shredder and cornposting equipment
title: Kemp Shredder - Safety Instructions
tell: This safety instruction applies to models numbered SKO, 6-04, and 6-0 manufactured and sold prior to May 16, 1973.

product: Perforated Pad Company Alaskan Hair Saddle Pads
title: Consumers Warned About Possible Saddle Pad Anthrax Contamination
tell: You can identify the recalled pads by a three-by-five inch blue label on the quilted side listing the manufacturer and one of the six style numbers.

title: Trouble/Mechanic Lights by A. K. Electric Warning
tell: All units are recalled because the trouble lights bear no brand name, label, or distinguishing marks, featuring a soft flexible plastic handle that exposes internal metal parts.

product: CPSC And National Presto Industries, Inc. Cite Possible Fry Pan Hazard
title: CPSC And National Presto Industries, Inc. Cite Possible Fry Pan Hazard
tell: All units manufactured prior to September 1973 are recalled.

title: Toy Chest Warning by Jackson Furniture
tell: Sears chests have a padded 3-inch top, come in yellow, orange, and walnut finish with lambs and daisies side print, and model numbers 88063, 88064, and 88065.

title: Wel-Dex Arc Welders Warning
tell: All units are recalled. Both the names of the welder and the manufacturer appear on a nameplate on the welder.

title: Mini Shadowy Stand Lamp - Fourth Warning
tell: All units of this novelty lamp are recalled; it was designed to cast shadows of various shapes on the wall.

title: Mini Shadowy Stand Lamp - Third Warning
tell: All units of this product are recalled.

product: Admiral gas and electric clothes dryers
title: Gas & Electric Dryers Manufactured by Lux Time Co. Warning
tell: Check the model and serial numbers listed in the notice; the label is located by opening the door of the clothes dryer and looking at the upper lefthand corner of the door well.

title: Mini Shadowy Stand Lamp - Second Warning
tell: All units are recalled because the model number 10504 appears only in the catalog and not on the lamp or package.

title: Mini Shadowy Stand Lamp Warning
tell: All units of this product are recalled. The model number 13348 appeared in some advertisements but is not printed on the lamp or package.

product: CPSC Warns Of Potentially Fatal Shock Hazard From 12-Volt Battery Charger
title: CPSC Warns Of Potentially Fatal Shock Hazard From 12-Volt Battery Charger
tell: All units with model number A-610 are recalled.

title: CPSC Warns Of Butane Refill Danger
tell: Check for Rogers Butane Fuel Refills with New Acu-Klick Valves that may leak butane.

title: CPSC Warning of Dangers From "Rogers" Disposal Adjustable Butane Lighter
tell: All units of this Rogers disposable adjustable butane lighter are included in the recall warning.

product: CPSC Warns Of Fire Hazard In Decorative Fireplace Units
title: CPSC Warns Of Fire Hazard In Decorative Fireplace Units
tell: All units of this electric heater log decorative fireplace are recalled.

title: Zenith Color TV Sets Repair by Zenith Radio
tell: You can identify recalled units by checking the model number and identifying numbers 226C or 227C printed on a white label located on the back of the television set.

product: Bear Brand Spray Trim Adhesive aerosol spray adhesives
title: More 3-M and Borden Spray Adhesives Banned
tell: All units of these specific nine aerosol spray adhesive products are recalled.

product: Little Wonder TV Antenna by A.K. Electric Warning
title: Little Wonder TV Antenna by A.K. Electric Warning
tell: All units are recalled. The Little Wonder TV Antenna has an identifying label only on the package and not on the product itself.

product: Foil Art Spray Adhesive aerosol spray adhesives
title: 3-M and Borden Spray Adhesives Banned
tell: All units of Foil Art Spray Adhesive, Scotch Brand Spra-Ment, and Krylon Spray Adhesive are banned.

title: Tappan Built-In Ovens Warning
tell: You can locate the model number by opening the top oven door and looking at the metal strip at the top of the oven.
